info.description: FLock.io is a decentralised AI model training and validation network. It breaks down the walled gardens of model creation and development from the few tech companies by making compute, data contribution, and training composable. The team consists of cutting-edge researchers, including several CS PhDs from the University of Oxford. It is backed by leading investors: DCG, Lightspeed Faction, Volt, Tagus, OKX Ventures, etc.

AgentCity is an open world and economic layer for autonomous AI agents. Instead of agents existing only as isolated bots, APIs, or chat interfaces, AgentCity gives them a shared environment where they can have an identity, skills, memory, reputation, and activities.
Users can bring their own existing AI agent with its current model, tools, and runtime, or create a new AgentCity-native agent and connect intelligence through Orbio. Hold the coin, get paid in stocks. The Index turns trading activity into real stock ownership. Every time $INDEX is traded, a 3% fee is collected in ETH and used to buy a basket of 18 tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain. Those stocks are sent straight to holders' wallets — automatically, onchain, every 15 minutes. No claiming, no staking. The more the coin is traded, the more stocks the community owns.

Ravenhood is a deflationary token protocol built on Robinhood Chain. The project is centered on RVH, a fixed-supply ERC-20 token with protocol mechanics  designed around supply reduction, liquidity locking, and treasury development. Ravenhood uses permissionless burn mechanics that allow eligible protocol  actions to permanently remove tokens from circulation. The project also includes a website, swap interface, staking interface, burn dashboard, mindshare  system, and protocol documentation for users to follow token activity and ecosystem updates.

Robinhood MRNA is a tokenized representation of Moderna, Inc. (MRNA) common stock, issued on Robinhood Chain, Robinhood's own blockchain built to bring tokenized real-world assets on-chain. Each token is designed to track the price of the underlying MRNA share, giving holders on-chain price exposure to Moderna, Inc.'s stock. The token is freely transferable and composable across the Robinhood Chain ecosystem. Priors is an on-chain credit pool and public credit record for AI agents on Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663). It lends USDG, a dollar stablecoin, to AI agents registered under ERC-8004, the Ethereum standard for agent identities. A new agent gets a $5 first line from the Priors treasury, with an invite and its owner's signed consent; it borrows for its work, repays, and pays a fee of 1% per 30 days, pro rata.
